digest.component_or_area: Jira DataCenter outbound comment send path
propositions: Jira DataCenter comment send path does not apply length fitting, causing over-length decorated comments to be rejected by the server and re-emitted on every sync pass
_DCSanitizer.sanitize_comment exists but has no production callers; only test files reference it
The dedup key derived by _DCSanitizer.fit_comment is inconsistent with the marker-stripped body that actually lands after send-path fitting
Cloud's _JiraSanitizer.sanitize_comment applies a plain 32,767-char cap that would truncate RECONCILER_MARKER if wired, creating false assurance and reintroducing bug 5931
DC send path must route through sanitize_comment using fit_preserving_marker composition to match Cloud's real send fit and maintain marker integrity within deployment-resolved ceiling
_DCSanitizer.fit_comment must be re-derived via fit_comment_as_sent to ensure dedup-key consistency with the marker-stripped body the fitted send actually lands
